findings.claim: A boolean NULL-placement key on fee placed first satisfies the fee-first test, so an untaught ORDER BY that never sorts priced courses by fee can still earn sort on this data.
findings.recommendation: Optionally require a fee-valued key or add a row that separates credits order from fee order.

findings.claim: A valid fee sort written with an ordinal ORDER BY key is told to sort by fee first, because the fee-first test only recognises a key naming the fee column.
findings.recommendation: Optionally resolve ordinal keys before the fee test.
